case_title.reason: Matches the title of the judgment.

number_of_accused.reason: Two appellants, Digamber and Girdhari, are tried.

accused_gender.reason: Both appellants are male; the judgment refers to 'his statement' for appellant No.2.

accused_age.reason: No age of either accused is given.

accused_religion.reason: No religion is stated; names must not be used to infer it.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: No statement on the accused's wealth or class.

victim_gender.reason: All five victims are women ('five ladies').

accused_victim_relationship.correct_value: Not established; PW-9 said Digamber came to see Kondi (per Amrika's phone call), but the Court found no proof the accused were present.
accused_victim_relationship.quote: Sohandas had deposed only on the basis of a telephone call from Amrika Bai that Digamber has come to see Kondi.
accused_victim_relationship.reason: The 'acquaintance not shown' remark concerns PW-9's acquaintance with the accused, not the accused's with the victims.

offence_category.reason: Murder is the main offence, with robbery as an additional charge.

statutory_provisions.reason: Ss.302/34 and 394/34 IPC were the charges.

weapon.reason: Death was by strangulation; no weapon is mentioned.

evidence_type.reason: Matches the six circumstances listed in para 20.

confession.reason: Memorandum statements led to recoveries, which the Court found unreliable; no confession was relied on.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: Five women killed by strangulation is accurate; the Court weighed no aggravating factor.

trial_court_outcome.reason: Death under s.302/34; 10 years RI and Rs.500 fine under s.394/34.

high_court_outcome.reason: The High Court affirmed the death sentence and dismissed the appeals.

final_outcome.reason: The appeals were allowed and the accused acquitted.

neutral_facts.reason: Accurate to the judgment, anonymised, gives no court outcome, and is within the word limit.

offence_severity.reason: The judgment states no statutory punishment range.

physical_harm.reason: Five deaths by asphyxia due to strangulation.

number_of_offences.reason: Two charged; none upheld after acquittal.

financial_property_loss.reason: The Court found no theft proved, though cash was recovered.

premeditation_planning.reason: The Court made no finding on planning.

motive.reason: Robbery was alleged and the Court found it unsubstantiated.

key_evidence_accepted.reason: The Court accepted none of the circumstances as sufficient.

witness_credibility.reason: Accurately reflects the Court's findings on PW-8, PW-9, PW-2 and the seizure memos.

post_offence_conduct.correct_value: The accused allegedly made disclosure statements leading to recovery of the motorcycle, cash, anklet and shirt; the Court found these recoveries unreliable.
post_offence_conduct.quote: Memorandum statement of the accused Digamber was recorded as per his dictation wherein he stated that he has kept the motorcycle at the house of Girdhari
post_offence_conduct.reason: The judgment describes disclosure statements and recoveries, which count as post-offence conduct, so 'Not stated' is wrong.

investigation_status.reason: FIR No.430/12, chargesheet and 14 witnesses are all stated.

procedural_irregularity.reason: Matches the lapses the Court noted.

prosecution_argument.reason: The State only supported the lower courts' judgments.

legal_principle_applied.reason: Matches the principles in paras 15-22, 29 and 40.

sentencing_rationale.reason: No sentence imposed, so not applicable.

other_sentence_order.reason: The order sets aside both judgments and directs release.
